description: SnapCal makes tracking your nutrition effortless. Simply describe what you eat in natural language and photos, and the AI will instantly estimate your calories and macronutrients (protein, carbs, and fats). View daily summaries, track your weight, and manage your diet with an interactive dashboard directlyinside ChatGPT.
